explanation: The nth derivative of tan(x) is a polynomial in tan(x) of degree n+1, so these functions are all distinct and A is infinite. The nth derivative of sin(3x) is 3^n sin(3x+nπ/2), producing infinitely many distinct amplitudes, so B is infinite. Derivatives of 3sin(x) cycle through 3sin(x), 3cos(x), -3sin(x), and -3cos(x), so C is finite.
